items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 37:1
items.html: The first are the records that remain from the discernment of clothing. The second are the records from the discernment of drawing. The third are the records that are clothed in their vessels. The fourth are the records that are not clothed in their own vessels but hover above the vessel, in the secret of Tagin. The fifth are the records that returned to their vessels after they had gone out from there. The sixth are the records that are included from coarse light and refined light, with no recognition by which to distinguish between them. The seventh are the records from the discernment of the refined light alone, from which the males of the second expansion were made. The eighth are the records from the discernment of the coarse light alone, from which the vessels for the males of the second expansion were made. The ninth is the record of the light of Malchut, which is only the discernment of refined light remaining from her light; but the discernment of the coarse light in her was concealed, and no record remained of it — that is, the record from the discernment of drawing in her, of which the ARI says that Malchut left no record. The tenth are the records that were included in the screen as it passed through the Sefirot on the way of its ascent to the Emanator, and that were renewed there in a new coupling for the second expansion. The eleventh are the records that remained from the first nine Sefirot that emerged at the time of the refining of the screen. The twelfth are the records from the last phases of those said levels. (Inner Observation, Item 40)
